<thought>Based on the observed isotopic series (regular 1 Da spacing) and the relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 11 % of M, M+2 ≈ 1 % of M), the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing roughly 10–11 carbons. No characteristic Cl, Br, S, or other element patterns are present. Thus, the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
